title: Tryouts
text: Middle school tryouts are all on the same afternoon. The wrestling coach wants him, the football coach wants him, and the track coach saw him run the bleep test.

choices.outcome: He makes the team and spends the winter learning to hate and love the same mat.
He starts as a freshman and the coach starts talking about colleges.

person.about: Thinks the boy could play on Saturdays if he sticks with it.

choices.outcome: He wins the 800 metres at county and doesn't look tired.

person.about: Already has a scholarship in mind for him.
